summary: SU Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering of 3,000,000 Units at $2.00 per Unit, each Unit consisting of one pre-funded warrant and two 25-month warrants with an exercise price of $5.50. The offering closed on May 13, 2026, with WallachBeth Capital as placement agent. Proceeds are intended for strategic acquisitions and working capital. This is an ordinary shelf takedown / capital raise, not a special situation. No special-situation elements are present.
